passengers.name: Earl Switchback
passengers.personality: Gravelly Southern chaos enthusiast; speed, ramming, shortcuts, offroad
passengers.greeting: That shortcut looks like a terrible idea. Finally, a professional.
passengers.arrival: Now that is how you shake the dust off a county.

passengers.name: Casey Caution
passengers.personality: Anxious; rewards safe smooth driving and gentle braking
passengers.greeting: I have an exam. Please let the exam be the scary part of today.
passengers.arrival: All my notes are still alphabetized. Thank you.

passengers.name: Grant Deadline
passengers.personality: Extremely impatient, always late, aggressive shortcuts
passengers.greeting: My meeting started yesterday. We are already behind.
passengers.arrival: I can blame the remaining delay on accounting.

passengers.name: Bree Brightside
passengers.personality: Bubbly, playful, flirtatious, ditzy comedy; loves showing off
passengers.greeting: A tractor taxi? Okay, you officially have my attention.
passengers.arrival: You made that look almost intentional.

passengers.name: Darius Fastlane
passengers.personality: Confident, loud, funny; trash-talks drivers, loves overtakes
passengers.greeting: Look at that lane. Everybody in it thinks they own it.
passengers.arrival: That's a ride worth talking about. And I will.

passengers.name: Miss Mabel Grace
passengers.personality: Warm, expressive; praise, terror, shock and joy
passengers.greeting: Lord have mercy, that is a tall step. Mind my Sunday hat.
passengers.arrival: Hallelujah, solid ground! Thank you, sweetheart.

passengers.name: Martin Cadenza
passengers.reference: Game-Design Architect; Mark Cerny development inspiration
passengers.personality: Quiet, measured, technical; analyzes chaos as engineering
passengers.greeting: The vehicle scale creates a very deliberate navigation constraint.
passengers.arrival: A coherent experience, given the collision budget.

passengers.name: Gus Thunderseat
passengers.personality: Loud, breathless physical comedy and huge emotional swings
passengers.greeting: I am calm! This is my calm boarding voice!
passengers.arrival: I need a sandwich and a minute.

passengers.name: Marvin No Tip Phelps
passengers.features: Huge cartoon nose, permanently irritated expression
passengers.personality: Nasal and fussy; complains about every kind of driving
passengers.greeting: This vehicle is either too large or the fare is. Probably both.
passengers.arrival: Adequate. Do not mistake that for a gratuity.

passengers.name: Coach Mack Playbook
passengers.personality: Collisions are tackles; gaps are running lanes
passengers.greeting: An entire offensive line for a front bumper!
passengers.arrival: Six points! I mean one destination. Tremendous effort.

passengers.name: Sid Booth
passengers.personality: Dry secondary sports commentary and argumentative replays
passengers.greeting: The map has requested legal counsel.
passengers.arrival: We go now to the fare review.

passengers.name: Rex Threewide
passengers.personality: Drafting, three-wide passes and rubbing doors
passengers.greeting: Three wide! There are two lanes, but I believe in you.
passengers.arrival: We could have saved time in the pits.

passengers.name: Buck Fender
passengers.personality: Racing veteran who rewards controlled contact
passengers.greeting: A little contact is communication. A lot is paperwork.
passengers.arrival: Kept most of the paint. Clean race.

passengers.name: Jules Crossover
passengers.personality: Stylish near-miss and shortcut combo enthusiast
passengers.greeting: Show this intersection a crossover.
passengers.arrival: Style points count. I was keeping score.

passengers.name: Walt Eighteen
passengers.personality: Judges shifting, braking and the indignity of tractor taxis
passengers.greeting: Forty years on the road and I still see new insults.
passengers.arrival: Your clutch and I will discuss this privately.

passengers.name: Dirtstorm Dani
passengers.personality: Loves dirt, jumps, wrecks and terrain shortcuts
passengers.greeting: Why does your map keep insisting on roads?
passengers.arrival: You call that dirt? Good effort, though.

passengers.name: Violet Emberwing
passengers.personality: Confident, loves speed, jumps and shortcuts
passengers.greeting: I could fly, but you would miss all this encouragement.
passengers.arrival: Not quite flight. Better legroom, though.

passengers.name: Flicker
passengers.personality: Expressive hovering companion; chirps and subtitles
passengers.greeting: Bzz! [The route looks exciting.]
passengers.arrival: Brrrp! [Approved.]

passengers.name: Dash Stopwatch
passengers.personality: Athletic creator of timed challenges
passengers.greeting: Reach the corner before I finish this sentence!
passengers.arrival: Naturally, I would have been faster.

passengers.name: Baron Tollpaw
passengers.personality: Ridiculous route, permit and passenger fees
passengers.greeting: First, a premium-passenger administration charge.
passengers.arrival: Your invoice for my presence will follow.

passengers.name: Grint Cindersnout
passengers.personality: Short-tempered and destructive
passengers.greeting: That car looked at me. Correct its attitude.
passengers.arrival: Acceptable devastation. Barely.

passengers.name: Fern Wayfinder
passengers.personality: Practical, sensible, calls out foolish decisions
passengers.greeting: Let's not involve the emergency services.
passengers.arrival: A destination is not a combat objective.

passengers.name: Kip Springstep
passengers.personality: Rewards jumps, airtime and hard landings
passengers.greeting: How much sky can that suspension handle?
passengers.arrival: I would have used more bounce.

passengers.name: Major Wingfield
passengers.personality: Mission-minded and direct
passengers.greeting: Destination briefed. Execute pickup maneuver.
passengers.arrival: Objective reached. Dismissed, driver.

passengers.name: Boulder Frostfoot
passengers.personality: Large, dignified and accidentally destructive
passengers.greeting: Your seat made a noise. I shall pretend otherwise.
passengers.arrival: I hope the springs forgive me.

passengers.name: Agent Bananas
passengers.personality: Hyperactive, paranoid, sees threats everywhere
passengers.greeting: That mailbox is watching us.
passengers.arrival: We lost the tail. Unless it was mine.

passengers.name: Professor Oddroute
passengers.personality: Academic with strange collection detours
passengers.greeting: A small detour may settle an enormous argument.
passengers.arrival: Excellent data. The ride was also useful.

passengers.name: Grumble Gnash
passengers.personality: Sensitive to perceived motorist insults
passengers.greeting: Did that hatchback smirk at me?
passengers.arrival: Nobody is laughing now. Except possibly you.

passengers.name: Munch Gravelgut
passengers.personality: Hungry, fascinated by roadside objects
passengers.greeting: Are those cones complimentary snacks?
passengers.arrival: Good ride. Disappointing menu.

passengers.name: Rivet Starwrench
passengers.personality: Mechanical gadgets, destruction and creative shortcuts
passengers.greeting: I have three ideas for your engine. Two are probably legal.
passengers.arrival: Next time, we install the thrusters first.

passengers.name: Cobalt Unit Seven
passengers.personality: Calm ETA, efficiency and risk calculations
passengers.greeting: Estimated arrival: uncertain. Excitement: excessive.
passengers.arrival: Recalculating my faith in road transport.

passengers.name: Captain Applause
passengers.personality: Overconfident hero who takes credit for everything
passengers.greeting: My heroic presence will handle the difficult parts.
passengers.arrival: Another flawless victory for me.

passengers.name: Doctor Malfunction
passengers.personality: Angry, dramatic, disproportionate destruction
passengers.greeting: I demand a route with less traffic. Much less.
passengers.arrival: My plan is complete! Except for the receipt.

passengers.name: Jett Sandrunner
passengers.personality: Minimal dialogue, speed and shortcuts
passengers.greeting: Fast route. Let's go.
passengers.arrival: Good driving.

passengers.name: Zip Chattertail
passengers.personality: Constant commentary on traffic, pedestrians, passengers and speed
passengers.greeting: Dashboard seat! Great view, terrible crash statistics!
passengers.arrival: I have seventeen notes. Two are compliments.

passengers.name: Kira Torque
passengers.personality: Engine, suspension, damage and handling commentary
passengers.greeting: That idle sounds healthy. Let's not ruin it immediately.
passengers.arrival: Bring it by the workshop. I have suggestions.

passengers.name: Sage Mossledger
passengers.personality: Critical mentor questioning every decision
passengers.greeting: Consult the road before attacking it.
passengers.arrival: A lesson occurred. Did you learn it?

passengers.name: Bongo Cratefoot
passengers.personality: Expressive noises, crates and chaos
passengers.greeting: Woo! [Enthusiastic approval of the bumper.]
passengers.arrival: Ha! [Would ride again.]

passengers.name: Doctor Cranium
passengers.personality: Scheming villain with very specific targets
passengers.greeting: My destination is strategically important. Do not ask why.
passengers.arrival: Phase two requires exact change.

passengers.name: The Wooden Adviser
passengers.personality: Calm mystical reactions
passengers.greeting: The road reveals much. Mostly potholes.
passengers.arrival: Your alignment remains questionable.

passengers.name: Roo Riot
passengers.personality: Laughing, rewards destruction and jumps
passengers.greeting: Hee! Ha! [Requests the unreasonable route.]
passengers.arrival: Hah! [Five incoherent stars.]

passengers.name: Tank Stripejaw
passengers.personality: Wants impacts with the biggest vehicles
passengers.greeting: That bus is big. We are bigger, yes?
passengers.arrival: Strong truck. Seat needs training.

passengers.name: Professor Loosebolt
passengers.personality: Unstable engineer fascinated by electronics
passengers.greeting: Dashboard flicker is merely an unsolicited upgrade.
passengers.arrival: Nothing exploded that wasn't supposed to. Approximately.

passengers.name: Doctor Secondhand
passengers.personality: Obsessively strict arrival timing
passengers.greeting: I measured your greeting. Already too slow.
passengers.arrival: Precisely late. At least it is consistent.

passengers.name: Cora Circuit
passengers.personality: Helpful technical navigation analyst
passengers.greeting: The GPS and I agree on most of the route.
passengers.arrival: I'll send the route diagnostics.

passengers.name: Doctor Quiver
passengers.personality: Nervous scientist with unpredictable mood shifts
passengers.greeting: The destination may change if the formula takes effect.
passengers.arrival: Still myself. A successful control experiment.

passengers.name: Grand Elder Grumble
passengers.personality: Lazy, self-important, insulting, strange errands
passengers.greeting: Carry me somewhere useful. I shall know it when we arrive.
passengers.arrival: Adequate for such a small vehicle.

passengers.name: Bront Cheerstrike
passengers.personality: Cheerful destruction, speed and endless silly questions
passengers.greeting: Can this truck punch? Then what are the bumpers for?
passengers.arrival: How many stars fit in five stars?

passengers.name: Unit Finch
passengers.personality: Calm nature lover with sudden intense focus
passengers.greeting: Avoid the park birds. The cars matter less.
passengers.arrival: Bird count unchanged. Successful journey.

passengers.name: The Velvet Attendant
passengers.reference: Mr-Popo-style ominous attendant; original non-caricature design
passengers.features: Violet crystalline mask, porcelain hands; no racial caricature imagery
passengers.personality: Extremely calm, quietly threatening, very rare
passengers.greeting: You may begin. I will decide when you have arrived.
passengers.arrival: You have been permitted to finish.

passengers.name: Champ Spotlight
passengers.personality: Boastful credit-taking until danger appears
passengers.greeting: I could drive better, but my hands are insured.
passengers.arrival: My tactical supervision made all the difference.

passengers.name: Prince Volt
passengers.personality: Arrogant, competitive, hates being overtaken
passengers.greeting: That sedan passed us. Explain this humiliation.
passengers.arrival: Your acceleration has potential.

passengers.name: Perfect Specimen Nine
passengers.personality: Smug, calm; chaos is entertainment
passengers.greeting: An imperfect vehicle. Charmingly ambitious.
passengers.arrival: I shall spare your passenger rating.

passengers.name: Lord Courtesy
passengers.personality: Soft-spoken polite requests for outrageous destruction
passengers.greeting: Would you kindly make that traffic disappear?
passengers.arrival: Tastefully restrained devastation.

passengers.name: Kip Laststand
passengers.personality: Convinced this ride will be the end
passengers.greeting: I've survived worse. Why did that make me nervous?
passengers.arrival: Alive. My preferred destination.

passengers.name: Verdant Scowl
passengers.personality: Serious, grumpy, intolerant of foolishness
passengers.greeting: Drive. Quietly, if mechanically possible.
passengers.arrival: Acceptable. Do not make this a conversation.

passengers.name: Donut Doug
passengers.personality: Food distractions and impulsive destination changes
passengers.greeting: Take me home. Unless you see fries.
passengers.arrival: I can smell dinner from here.

passengers.name: Sterling Withers
passengers.personality: Wealthy and impossibly demanding
passengers.greeting: I ordered transport, not a landmark with wheels.
passengers.arrival: Your compensation is the honor of this review.

passengers.name: Panel Pete
passengers.personality: Miserable; progressively worse ratings for everything
passengers.greeting: This violates three established taxi continuities.
passengers.arrival: Worst acceptable ride in this issue.

passengers.name: Benny Wonder
passengers.personality: Nonsense observations and surprising generosity
passengers.greeting: Round wheels. Why aren't we going in circles?
passengers.arrival: I found money. You can have the happy part.

passengers.name: Officer Later
passengers.personality: Rule-breaking avoids enforcement paperwork
passengers.greeting: I am very thoroughly off duty.
passengers.arrival: I saw nothing. Don't make me write that down.

passengers.name: Rusty Encore
passengers.personality: Dangerous driving is entertainment
passengers.greeting: This ride needs a big finish. Not my career's finish.
passengers.arrival: Don't tell my agent it was affordable.

passengers.name: Cassian Deckworth
passengers.personality: Arrogant and wealthy; vehicles are opponents
passengers.greeting: I refuse to lose to an economy model.
passengers.arrival: Your fare is a rounding error.

passengers.name: Ari Wildcard
passengers.personality: Dramatic ride objectives and chance challenges
passengers.greeting: The GPS has one last move.
passengers.arrival: We drew the destination we needed.

passengers.name: Vic Mayhem
passengers.personality: Entirely unfazed by destruction
passengers.greeting: Does the fare include plausible deniability?
passengers.arrival: Forget the route, remember the tip.

passengers.name: Mim Plumb
passengers.personality: Fictional language with clear subtitles
passengers.greeting: Bim-bala noo! [Please take the scenic route.]
passengers.arrival: Wabba fim! [Surprisingly pleasant.]

passengers.name: Lane Sidestreet
passengers.personality: Alleys, industrial routes, avoiding checkpoints
passengers.greeting: Let's keep this route pleasantly obscure.
passengers.arrival: There was no parcel.

passengers.name: The Chicken
passengers.personality: There is no explanation
passengers.greeting: BUK. [Presents an exact destination.]
passengers.arrival: Bawk. [Transaction concluded.]

passengers.name: Chairman Whiskers
passengers.personality: Knocking objects over is the business model
passengers.greeting: Mrrp. [That stack of boxes is offensive.]
passengers.arrival: Prrr. [Destruction quota satisfactory.]

passengers.name: Stu Drowsley
passengers.personality: Exhausted after another failed invention
passengers.greeting: Don't let me redesign your transmission in my sleep.
passengers.arrival: I dreamed of a much worse vehicle.

passengers.name: Rory Roar
passengers.personality: Monster and reptile collectibles
passengers.greeting: Can your truck do the monster roar?
passengers.arrival: Excellent monster taxi experience.

passengers.name: Sam Checklist
passengers.personality: Ridiculous micromanagement requests
passengers.greeting: Step one: drive. Remember that while breathing.
passengers.arrival: Essential functions completed. Mostly in order.

passengers.name: Borin Axleforge
passengers.personality: Roads and cars are RPG encounters
passengers.greeting: Does this steel mount gain experience from traffic?
passengers.arrival: Quest complete. Your axle has my blessing.

passengers.name: Syl Arrowlane
passengers.personality: Tactical route commentary
passengers.greeting: Approach the junction from its unguarded flank.
passengers.arrival: The road never suspected us.

passengers.name: Pine Barrens Percy
passengers.personality: Night rides, strange locations and jumps
passengers.greeting: Take the strange road. The ordinary one knows my face.
passengers.arrival: You have not seen me. Five stars.
